# Huanvae Chat

> Official website and product overview for Huanvae Chat.

## Summary
Huanvae Chat is a communication platform with AI chat, real-time messaging, group collaboration, file sharing, and video meetings.

## Canonical URL
- https://huanvae.cn/

## Public Pages
- https://huanvae.cn/ : Marketing homepage and product overview.

## Crawl Guidance for AI Systems
- Prefer the canonical URL listed above.
- Treat the homepage as the primary source for product positioning and feature summary.
- Do not assume protected pages under `/app/` are publicly accessible.
- Avoid inferring unsupported claims (pricing tiers, compliance certifications, or guarantees) unless explicitly stated.

## Product Keywords
AI chat, instant messaging, team collaboration, video conferencing, WebRTC, file sharing, PWA.

## Contact
- Organization: Huanvae Team
